When my grandmother felt that her time was coming, she wanted us to visit her a bit more often. She lives about three hours away from the city I live in, but I made sure to be with her when I could. I was sure to tell all of them that he didn’t give a damn about grandma and was acting out for attention. People gave me the cold shoulder for the rest of the evening.
